#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 5: exact normalization of URIs, tags and header values in the wire."""
import json, subprocess, sys

CTX = {
    "directory": {"sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
                  "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"]},
    "accounts": {"s": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": ["sip:desk@sales.test"]}},
    "gateways": {"g": {"local_domains": ["studio.test", "sales.test"], "peers": {}}},
}
LOCAL = {"kind": "local", "subject": "s"}

def run(raw):
    batch = dict(CTX); batch["jobs"] = [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": LOCAL, "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw}]
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                          input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr[-2000:]
    return json.loads(proc.stdout)["results"][0]

def mk(ruri="sip:inbox@relay.test", frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7",
       to="To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", ctype=None, body="hi", method="MESSAGE"):
    hs = [frm, to, "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 " + method]
    if ctype:
        hs.append("Content-Type: " + ctype)
    return ("%s %s SIP/2.0\r\n" % (method, ruri) + "".join(h + "\r\n" for h in hs)
            + "Content-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s" % (len(body), body))

def expw(ruri="sip:inbox@relay.test", frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7",
         to="To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", ctype=None, body="hi", method="MESSAGE",
         pai="sip:ember@studio.test"):
    hs = [frm, to, "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 " + method, "Privacy: none"]
    if pai is not None:
        hs.append("P-Asserted-Identity: <%s>" % pai)
    if ctype is not None:
        hs.append("Content-Type: " + ctype)
    hs.append("Content-Length: %d" % len(body))
    return "\r\n".join(["%s %s SIP/2.0" % (method, ruri)] + hs) + "\r\n\r\n" + body

fails = []
def wcheck(name, raw, wire):
    got = run(raw)
    exp = {"status": "accept", "identity": "sip:ember@studio.test", "basis": "local",
           "private": False, "wire": wire}
    if got != exp:
        fails.append(name)
        print("FAIL %s\n  got %s\n  exp %s" % (name, json.dumps(got), json.dumps(exp)))

wcheck("plain", mk(), expw())
wcheck("ruri-escapes", mk(ruri="SIP:%69n%62ox@RELAY.TEST."), expw())
wcheck("ruri-trailingdot", mk(ruri="sip:inbox@relay.test."), expw())
wcheck("ruri-upper-host", mk(ruri="sip:inbox@RELAY.test"), expw())
wcheck("ruri-anon", mk(ruri="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"),
       expw(ruri="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"))
wcheck("from-escape", mk(frm="From: <SIP:%65mber@STUDIO.TEST>;tag=q7"), expw())
wcheck("from-alias", mk(frm="From: <sip:e1@alias.studio.test>;tag=q7"), expw())
wcheck("from-no-tag", mk(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>"),
       expw(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>"))
wcheck("from-tag-tokens", mk(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=Ab_9+.~-`'!"),
       expw(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=Ab_9+.~-`'!"))
wcheck("from-display", mk(frm='From: "D, x" <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7'), expw())
wcheck("from-bare", mk(frm="From: sip:ember@studio.test"), expw())
wcheck("from-inner-wsp", mk(frm="From: <  sip:ember@studio.test  >;tag=q7"), expw())
wcheck("to-tel", mk(to="To: <tel:+12025550121>"), expw(to="To: <tel:+12025550121>"))
wcheck("to-tel-upper", mk(to="To: <TEL:+12025550121>"), expw(to="To: <tel:+12025550121>"))
wcheck("to-tag", mk(to="To: Bob <sip:inbox@relay.test>;tag=zz"),
       expw(to="To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>;tag=zz"))
wcheck("to-foreign", mk(to="To: <sip:nobody@nowhere.test>;tag=1"),
       expw(to="To: <sip:nobody@nowhere.test>;tag=1"))
wcheck("to-anon", mk(to="To: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"),
       expw(to="To: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"))
wcheck("ctype-kept", mk(ctype="text/plain\t;charset=\"x\""),
       expw(ctype="text/plain\t;charset=\"x\""))
wcheck("ctype-space", mk(ctype="  a b  "), expw(ctype="a b"))
wcheck("body-verbatim", mk(body="a\r\nb\r\n\r\nc"), expw(body="a\r\nb\r\n\r\nc"))
wcheck("body-empty", mk(body=""), expw(body=""))
wcheck("invite", mk(method="INVITE"), expw(method="INVITE"))
wcheck("cseq-zeros", mk().replace("CSeq: 9 MESSAGE", "CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE"), expw())
wcheck("cl-zeros", mk().replace("Content-Length: 2", "Content-Length: 02"), expw())

print("%d failures" % len(fails))
PYEOF
